reason: The commit only adjusts internal decoder-buffer bookkeeping and adds a debug assertion; it does not add an entry point, alter the decoding API, require new initialization or configuration, or impose a new caller-controlled input constraint. The existing harness already invokes BrotliDecoderDecompressStream repeatedly on one BrotliDecoderState with both whole-input and 1-to-7-byte chunking, which is the relevant high-level streaming path for the changed buffer-depletion behavior.
evidence: SaveErrorCode now resets s->buffer_length when the internal buffer is depleted: s->br.next_in == s->br.last_in.
BrotliDecoderDecompressStream only gains BROTLI_DCHECK(s->buffer_length < 8) before appending another byte to the existing internal buffer.
The public call signature and result protocol of BrotliDecoderDecompressStream are unchanged.

decode_fuzzer.c already creates a decoder with BrotliDecoderCreateInstance and repeatedly supplies incrementally chunked input through BrotliDecoderDecompressStream using addend values up to 7, while also testing the full-input path.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harness unchanged.
